title: Auto farm and auto buy egg
features: Hatch a PetA powerful and fully featured GUI script for Hatch a Pet designed to automate farming, purchasing, and utility functions with built-in configuration saving.📋 Features & Functionalities1. 🏠 Main Tab (Farming & Automation)Auto Collect Money: Automatically triggers money collection areas (CollectTrigger) on the map using touch interest or teleportation.Collect Delay Slider: Adjustable delay for money collection (1–100 seconds).Auto Pet Collect: Automatically invokes the remote server event/function to collect pets on a loop.Pet Delay Slider: Adjustable delay for pet collection (1–100 seconds).2. 🛒 Shop Tab (Items & Eggs Automation)Item Selection Dropdown: Choose specific items from the store (Strength Berry, Luck Software, Overclocker, Pet Perfume, etc.).Auto Buy Items: Automatically buys only the items you selected.Auto Buy All Items: Automatically purchases all available items in the shop.Egg Selection Dropdown: Choose specific eggs (Basic Egg, Forest Egg, Arctic Egg, Blooming Egg, etc.).Auto Buy Egg: Automatically purchases only the selected eggs.Auto Buy All Egg: Automatically buys all egg types available in the game.Custom Buy Amount: Input any custom egg purchase quantity (from 1 up to 500,000).Cost Calculator Display: Calculates and displays the total money cost for your selected eggs and bulk purchase multiplier in real-time.3. ⚙️ Misc Tab (Utilities & Performance)FPS Limiter: Set custom FPS limits directly in-game (setfpscap).WalkSpeed Toggle & Slider: Modify your character's movement speed (from 25 to 100). Resets to default (16) when disabled.Anti-AFK System: Automatically simulates clicks every 10 minutes to prevent Roblox from disconnecting you due to inactivity.4. 💾 Config & UI SystemAuto Save & Load Config: Automatically saves your toggles, selected items/eggs, sliders, and settings to a JSON file (RixHubScriptHatchAPet_Config.json).Clean & Modern Draggable GUI: Includes tab navigation (Main, Shop, Misc) and a draggable open/close toggle button.Auto Cleanup: Automatically removes old versions of the GUI upon re-executing.Executor Compatibility✅ ALL OTHER EXECUTORS SUPPORTED!
